title: First-Run Compass: Quickstart Landing Visual Language & Step Map
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Goal: Create a cohesive visual language and modular step map for the Quickstart landing that reduces time-to-first-success for new developers and clarifies the onboarding path for a mix of self-serve and enterprise users. Deliverables: 1) Three hero variants (Developer Focus, Enterprise Trust, Compact Quickstart) with motion specs; 2) Modular step map component (tile/grid + progressive reveal) with copy and microcopy for each step; 3) Annotated screenshot set (desktop/tablet/mobile) and production-ready exports (AVIF/WebP/PNG fallbacks); 4) Accessibility and performance constraints, handoff tokens and component specs for engineering. Constraints: keep hero LCP target <= 1.2s, assets under 200KB each where possible, maintain contrast ratios AA+ for all copy, support i18n for en/es/fr, and avoid using large hero video assets for initial rollout.
screenshot_requirements: - Hero full-bleed desktop 1440x600 (AVIF primary, WebP/PNG fallback). - Hero compact mobile 420x280 with stacked step rail. - Step map wide 1280x320 with interactive hotspots (for animated prototype). - Code sample screenshot pairs: REST cURL and JS SDK, both with copy-to-clipboard state. - Admin/Dedicated variant showing Dedicated capacity toggle and SLA badge. - Provide masked example with sensitive data sanitized for public docs.
acceptance_criteria: Three hero variants reviewed and approved by PM and Eng (review comments resolved)
Step map component documented in Figma with tokens, spacing, and responsive rules
Annotated export pack uploaded to Drive with named files and production formats
Automated screenshot capture added to Percy and passing visual diffs for hero and step states
Accessibility audit passed (contrast, semantic headings, keyboard nav for step rail)
